'''Cyphar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] between [[Nkllon/Legends|Nkllon]] and [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], [[Battle of Cyphar|defended]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
